object_description: well-proportioned angled point building with a compact volume
design_condition: The concentrated point building is oriented toward Gotthelfstrasse and placed to preserve the existing trees, opening generous outdoor spaces at different heights while maintaining the district’s flowing green character.

positive.statement: The concentration of the day care in a point building opens generous outdoor spaces at different heights.

position.target: generous outdoor spaces at different heights
position.rationale: Outdoor space is approximated around the lower southern and western building edges.

positive.statement: The preserved and newly planted trees strengthen the impression of flowing green space.

position.rationale: Trees are not distinguishable; placement marks a plausible peripheral landscape zone.

positive.statement: The angled geometry enables precise placement in relation to the street, terraced open space, and kindergarten.

position.rationale: The angled footprint and pointed southern edge are clearly visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The well-proportioned volume appears self-confident in its shape.

position.rationale: The compact volume is represented by its upper central mass and balanced perimeter.

positive.statement: The bend accentuates the main entrance and cleverly locates the building on the street.

position.rationale: The entrance is constrained to the bent street-facing southern tip.

positive.statement: The large window areas logically support connections from inside to outside.

position.rationale: Window fields are represented on the visibly articulated western facade.

positive.statement: The deep parapets ensure a high level of light.

position.rationale: Parapet bands are approximated along the south-facing elevation at upper levels.

positive.statement: The floor-by-floor organization around the distribution core is rational and optimized.

position.target: floor-by-floor organization around the distribution core
position.rationale: The internal core is not separable, so the organization is anchored near the compact central mass.

positive.statement: The enfilade supports the spatial sequence and generates many perspectives and spatial references.

position.rationale: The spatial sequence is approximated along the building’s longer diagonal interior direction.

positive.statement: The technical requirements for acoustics and ventilation can be organized well.

position.target: technical requirements for acoustics and ventilation
position.rationale: This performance judgment has no distinct geometric marker in the sampled exterior.

positive.statement: The strict spatial organization has a certain flexibility of use.

position.rationale: Flexibility is assigned broadly to the compact organized building volume.

negative.statement: The proposed use and design of the southern tip are not yet convincing.

position.rationale: The pointed southern tip is clearly identifiable in plan and southern elevation.

negative.statement: The path connects all areas but also separates the green spaces from one another.

position.rationale: The path is approximated along the lower external edge where outdoor areas would connect.

negative.statement: The obstacle-free connection and development of the outdoor spaces are not clearly shown.

position.target: obstacle-free connection and development of outdoor spaces
position.rationale: Outdoor access is anchored to the lower western perimeter, where site connections are most plausible.

negative.statement: The sliding-window solution remains questionable in terms of facade appearance, functionality, and safety.

position.rationale: The window issue is assigned to the prominent eastern facade surface.

negative.statement: The dirty and dry areas are mixed unfavorably in the central core.

position.rationale: The central core is approximated near the compact footprint center across the vertical stack.

negative.statement: The desired retreat options and child-friendly atmosphere still need to be proven.

position.rationale: Interior retreat areas are approximated toward the quieter northern side of the mass.

negative.statement: One main staircase cannot achieve the necessary separation of the children’s groups.

position.rationale: The staircase is assigned to the likely central vertical circulation zone.

negative.statement: The stair exits and toilet units create overly narrow spatial conditions.

position.rationale: Narrow service and circulation conditions are approximated around the central core.

negative.statement: The outdoor spaces of the individual units can only be reached via the main staircase.

position.target: outdoor spaces of the individual units
position.rationale: Unit outdoor access is placed along the lower eastern edge adjacent to the building.

negative.statement: The office space is not optimally designed.

position.rationale: The office is not visible internally; it is approximated in an upper northern zone.

negative.statement: There is insufficient space for bicycles and kickboards in front of the entrance.

position.target: bicycles and kickboards in front of the entrance
position.rationale: Storage demand is anchored immediately outside the southern entrance area.
